description: Complete mapping of all UI fields in PropertyForm to database columns. Every field that appears in the Edit Property UI is documented here with its storage location.

databaseTables.properties: Main property table with core fields
databaseTables.properties.amenities: JSONB column storing 100+ extended property attributes
databaseTables.properties.images: JSONB column storing property image URLs
databaseTables.hostfully_room_types: Room types for Hostfully-integrated properties (44 columns)
databaseTables.pms_room_types_cache: Cached room types from any PMS

general.description: Core property information, contact details, location, PMS integration, and finance

info-facilities.description: Property description, star rating, facilities, house rules, and policies

fields.notes: Array of facility slugs from facilityCategories config
Array of image URLs or objects with url/alt properties

addons.description: Additional services and products that can be added to bookings

rates.description: Rate types, seasons, and pricing configuration

fields.notes: Nested object: seasonId -> roomTypeId -> rateTypeId -> amount

overview.description: Visual calendar overview of rates across rooms and seasons

data-explorer.description: Raw data viewer for debugging rate configuration

rooms.description: Room types and their configurations. Each room type has 6 sub-tabs.

fields.notes: For non-Hostfully properties. Hostfully rooms stored in hostfully_room_types table.

room-type.description: Core room information, capacity, and Hostfully-synced fields

rate-types.description: Link room to available rate types

amenities.description: Room-level amenities (can be synced from Hostfully)

fields.notes: Array of amenity strings from Hostfully
Array of image URLs or objects

conference.description: Conference venue and meeting room configuration
